title: Config Pre-Seed: pi-openai-compat
description: Pre-seed pi-openai-compat config with both Ollama and OpenWebUI providers, empty cachedModels to trigger live fetch on first run.

steps.description: Config pre-seed command for the image.
Setup: mkdir -p for config directory, printf writes JSON config.
Root: previousModel null, providers object starts.
Ollama: displayName, baseUrl host.docker.internal:11434/v1, apiKey null, cachedModels empty.
